name: Installing and setting up the FLEX IPTV app

actions.name: To watch IPTV on an Apple device, install the Flex IPTV player from the App Store.
Once the player is installed, open it. You will see a sample channel list.
The player comes with a demo playlist, which you can delete if you wish. Tap the three-line menu icon in the top-left corner to open the main menu.
Tap "Playlists manager" to open the playlist management menu.
Tap "Add Playlist" and enter your playlist URL. You can choose any name for the playlist; in this example, it is called "playlist01". Then tap "Download".
If the playlist URL was entered correctly, the playlist will appear in the list along with the number of channels it contains.
Open the main menu again and tap "Settings".

actions.name: Wait for the download to complete.
Once the download is complete, return to the main menu, select your playlist ("playlist01" in this example), and open its main screen.
Tap the three-dot icon in the top-right corner to open the additional options menu.
Tap the gear icon to open the settings menu, then enable the TV guide by turning on the "Show EPG" toggle.
Below are a few screenshots showing the player's menus, including the menu where you can hide categories you don't need.
NOTE: The channel lineup shown in the screenshots may differ from yours. It depends on the IPTV provider (playlist) you have selected.
